field.name: organization_id
field.label: COM_XDECAROCOMPETITIONS_FIELD_ORGANIZATION
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(name, IF(short_name IS NULL OR short_name = '', '', CONCAT(' (', short_name, ')'))) AS text FROM #__xdecarocompetitions_organizations WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY ordering ASC, name ASC

field.name: country_ids
field.label: COM_XDECAROCOMPETITIONS_COUNTRIES
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(name, ' (', code, ')') AS text FROM #__xdecarocompetitions_countries WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY name ASC
